Experience building LLM-based agent systems in production: orchestration, evaluation harnesses, prompt and model versioning, and cost control. jobs.description: Amazon Studios is the original content arm of Amazon.com, responsible for producing content that engages our customers across the globe, including successful series/shows such as "Family Man", "Raakh", and "Matka King". We are seeking an experienced contract administrator/business affairs coordinator, who's role will be two fold: this individual will be involved in heavily administrative functions as well as work closely with Business Affairs Lead and Business Affairs execs to coordinate on business affairs matters with internal and external stakeholders across all shows/movies as well as on downstream talent deals. A successful candidate will need to have a good working knowledge of the basics on deal making in the India entertainment industry; have dealt with paperwork/contracts at a basic level, have high level of organisational skills and be able to handle high volume tasks at a given time. Their prior experience of working for an entertainment agency, studio or organization will be helpful; and provide turnaround quickly with little to no guidance; react with appropriate urgency to situations and events that require quick response or turnaround. The candidate will also have excellent attention to detail and organizational skills. A high level of competence integrity and discretion in handling confidential information and professionalism in dealing with senior professionals inside and outside the company is key. This position is located in Mumbai. Key job responsibilities Contract Administration & Management Processing contracts for original content productions, including talent agreements, production services agreements, licensing deals, and ancillary agreements Managing the end-to-end contract lifecycle from initiation through execution, ensuring timely turnaround and compliance with internal policies Coordinating contract amendments, extensions, and renewals in alignment with business requirements Maintaining accurate and up-to-date contract records across internal systems and databases Rights Management Administering rights management tools and systems to track content rights, license windows, and territorial availability Ensuring accurate entry and maintenance of deal and title information, including key dates, statuses, and rights parameters Conducting periodic audits of rights data to identify and resolve discrepancies or data quality issues Supporting rights clearance processes for content distribution across multiple territories Stakeholder Coordination Serving as a key liaison between Business Affairs, Creative, Production, Marketing, Accounting, Finance, and Legal teams Coordinating with external partners including production houses, talent representatives, and vendors to facilitate contract execution Managing communication workflows to ensure all parties are aligned on deal terms, timelines, and deliverables Escalating issues and flagging risks to senior Business Affairs leadership in a timely manner Deal Support & Documentation Assisting Business Affairs Executives in structuring and closing deals by preparing deal summaries, comparison sheets, and financial breakdowns Tracking deal milestones, payment schedules, and deliverable timelines to ensure contractual obligations are met Preparing and maintaining deal trackers, status reports, and dashboards for leadership visibility Supporting due diligence processes by gathering and organizing relevant documentation Process Management & Compliance Ensuring adherence to internal approval workflows, signature protocols, and compliance requirements Raising and managing tickets for data corrections, system updates, and process exceptions Identifying opportunities for process improvement and contributing to the development of standard operating procedures Supporting cross-functional initiatives related to system implementations, tool migrations, and workflow optimization Multi-Territory Support Providing contract administration support across multiple territories and regions Adapting to varying legal frameworks, business practices, and operational requirements across geographies Stepping up to cover additional territorial responsibilities during transition periods or team changes Reporting & Analytics Generating regular reports on contract status, deal pipeline, and key performance metrics Tracking turnaround times, SLA adherence, and workload distribution for business review meetings Contributing data and insights for weekly, monthly, and quarterly business reviews A day in the life As a Business Affairs Coordinator, no two days are the same — but every day is fast-paced. You'll start your morning triaging contract requests and updating rights management systems, ensuring deal data is accurate and current across territories. By midday, you're coordinating with Creative, Legal, Finance, and Production teams to keep deals moving forward. Afternoons are spent processing contracts, preparing deal summaries for executives in active negotiations, and tracking milestones to ensure nothing falls through the cracks. You'll wrap up the day updating trackers, flagging escalations, and handing off to international counterparts across time zones. This role is ideal for someone who thrives on organization, loves working at the intersection of content and commerce, and can juggle multiple priorities without missing a beat. About the team Who We Are We are a close-knit team of 8 within Business Affairs at Amazon Studios, responsible for the contractual and rights management backbone that powers content across multiple territories. We sit at the intersection of creative ambition and business execution — ensuring that every deal, agreement, and rights window is structured, documented, and delivered with precision. Our Mission To enable the seamless acquisition, production, and distribution of world-class content by providing best-in-class business affairs support — moving at the speed of the business while maintaining the highest standards of accuracy and compliance. Our Culture We believe great work doesn't have to come at the cost of a great work environment. Our team culture is built on three pillars: Fun — We celebrate wins (big and small), share laughs over coffee, and genuinely enjoy each other's company. Whether it's a team lunch after closing a complex deal or friendly banter on a busy afternoon, we don't take ourselves too seriously. Learning — We are endlessly curious. From cross-training on new territories to deep-diving into evolving industry practices, we invest in each other's growth. Questions are encouraged, knowledge is shared freely, and no one is expected to have all the answers on day one. Work — When it's go-time, we deliver. We take pride in our craft — the precision of a well-structured deal, the satisfaction of a clean data set, the reliability of meeting every deadline. We hold ourselves and each other to a high bar, and we have each other's backs when the pressure is on. What You Can Expect Joining this team means joining a group that will challenge you, support you, and make you better at what you do — all while making sure you enjoy the ride. We move fast, we learn constantly, and we have fun doing it.

DoorDash Labs is an independent team within DoorDash. We are seeking a highly motivated and detail-oriented Hardware Integration Engineer to join our team. You will work directly with our hardware team on the buildout, testing, and maintenance of the next generation of robotic systems within DoorDash Labs. Through your daily interactions with all aspects of the autonomous system, you will serve as the lead technical reference. You will work directly with our hardware/software engineers, engineering technicians, operations, and safety team to improve the utilization rate and safety of our autonomous vehicles.
You’ll work closely with hardware and service engineering teams to tackle novel technical challenges in electromechanical systems and vehicle platforms. This is a role for someone who thrives in a fast-paced, hands-on environment and is passionate about building and refining robotic systems.

Construct and engineer test benches to validate mechanical, electrical, embedded, and software systems.
Create and maintain all necessary documentation pertaining to vehicle integration and detailed assembly procedures.
Employ root cause analysis to troubleshoot vehicle systems, computer components, and sensors, ensuring minimal downtime.
Manage and scale component provisioning and validation efforts to effectively support expanding vehicle fleets.
Collaborate across teams to satisfy the provisioning and validation requirements for various projects.
Address high-level, dynamically evolving technical challenges autonomously, maintaining a strict focus on safety.

BS/MS in Electrical Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, or a related technical field.

Knowledge of communication protocols such as DRONECAN/CAN/UART
Experience flashing software/firmware updates on hardware
Hands-on experience assembling, working with, and debugging hardware and software systems
You have experience with low-volume manufacturing in the automotive, drone or robotics industry.
Hobbies building robots, RC Cars Boats or Drones or playing with Arduinos/RPIs

jobs.description: Want to work for a Berkshire Hathaway company? Here’s your opportunity! We are a commercial property & casualty insurance company looking to fill entry-level underwriting positions. We consider a variety of backgrounds and do not require insurance experience . Our on-the-job training provides the right candidate the opportunity to be successful in this position. What is underwriting? Insurance underwriters use analytical skills to review information from an applicant to evaluate the degree of risk involved in a business or operation to determine if the applicant should be approved for a policy. The underwriter then uses our technology and data to determine the coverages to provide and the premium to be charged for the risk. Our underwriting professionals utilize strong communication and customer service skills by asking questions and making decisions over the phone and via e-mail with our agents. What will you do? UNDERWRITING ACTIVITIES : Reviews submissions, endorsement request and/or renewal policies from agents for acceptability prior to quoting. Follows up with agent or broker for additional information, as necessary. Determines proper classification of risks and uses company software to rate risks. Identifies proper coverage structure for risk including any policy endorsements and exclusions required, develops proposed rating, and applies schedule credits/debits within company guidelines. Makes underwriting decisions on routine insurance risks and refers risks outside underwriting authority to appropriate referral underwriting resource, as appropriate. QUOTING: Prepares and delivers quotes to agents within underwriting authority or with proper referral underwriting approval, as appropriate. Resolves outstanding concerns with agent, answers questions, and may negotiate changes, as appropriate. Explains commercial coverage to agents and/or brokers. Ensures the terms and conditions of the quotes are clearly outlined and guides agent through binding process. Manages pending workload to ensure agencies receive excellent service on quotes when needed. QUALITY CONTROL AND REVIEW: Performs quality control inspections of system bound policies, endorsements, and renewal policies. Reviews applications, agency correspondence, and other underwriting information received versus policy to reconcile any discrepancies or errors and to ensure accurate information is contained in policy. Reviews proper rating classification and coding of bound policies using combination of information available in application, loss control inspections, and telephone conversations with agents and brokers. Handles problems and takes appropriate action on unusual discrepancies. Initiates policy changes and takes underwriting actions as appropriate within underwriting authority including cancellation or non-renewal. THIRD PARTY DATA: Utilizes third party tools, data, and services to enable better underwriting decisions, improve accuracy of rating/exposure information, and produce better underwriting results. QUALITY ASSURANCE AND TESTING: Participates in the testing of rating, quoting, policy administration, and other software as required including the completion of assigned test cases within designated time frame. We operate at the front line of real-world safety and risk management, translating user and operational signals into timely decisions, effective interventions, and improvements to our systems. This role sits on a team focused on building operational capacity for new, ambiguous, and fast-moving areas of work. The team defines what needs to be built, creates the operating model to support it, and works with partner teams to make the work scalable and durable over time. About the Role We are seeking a Device Safety & Risk Operations Specialist to build the safety operating model for a new category of consumer hardware. This is a senior individual-contributor role for someone who can turn emerging product risks and incomplete requirements into practical workflows, controls, launch plans, and durable systems. You will define how product-safety incidents, critical escalations, regulated cases, and privacy-sensitive issues should be identified, investigated, escalated, resolved, and learned from. You will also establish operational requirements for case management, data access, decision logging, quality assurance, monitoring, and cross-functional response. You will stand up priority workflows through launch and early operations, then help transition them into durable homes across USRO and partner teams. The right person combines deep operational judgment with strong technical and hardware product fluency. They can move from executive-level risk framing to detailed workflow design, tabletop exercises, launch readiness, frontline guidance, and post-launch improvement. Location / work model: San Francisco, CA; hybrid, 3 days/week in-office. Please note: This role may involve exposure to sensitive or concerning material. Strong discretion, judgment, and resilience are essential. In This Role, You Will: - Build the end-to-end safety and risk operating model for new consumer hardware, from early requirements through launch and early-life operations. - Define incident taxonomies, severity levels, decision rights, escalation criteria, response pathways, and closure standards. - Develop operational playbooks for product-safety incidents, critical escalations, safety advisories, corrective actions, and other high-risk events. - Design workflows for regulated and privacy-sensitive cases, including restricted handling, evidence requirements, auditability, and partner escalation. - Translate safety and operational needs into requirements for tooling, case management, data access, monitoring, logging, and automation. - Establish clear ownership boundaries across Product, Engineering, Legal, Privacy, Product Policy, Support, Product Quality, and other operational partners. - Build launch-readiness plans, tabletop exercises, training, quality controls, reporting, and post-launch monitoring. - Use operational data, customer signals, product telemetry, and case outcomes to identify patterns and improve upstream products and systems. - Determine where AI and automation can improve triage, evidence assembly, consistency, and response while preserving appropriate human judgment. - Stand up priority workflows, operate them through launch and early-life stabilization, and transition them into durable homes across USRO and partner teams. You Might Thrive in This Role If You: - Have 8+ years of relevant experience in device safety, product safety, consumer hardware operations, technical program management, or a related field. - Have built a complex safety or risk program from an ambiguous starting point through launch and scaled operation. - Understand the realities of handling high-severity incidents, regulated workflows, sensitive customer information, and time-critical escalations. - Can translate product, engineering, legal, privacy, and policy constraints into workflows that operational teams can execute. - Are technically fluent and can reason through data flows, telemetry, access controls, audit logs, case systems, automation, and failure modes. - Use data to assess workflow health, identify emerging patterns, evaluate quality, and make risk-based decisions. - Can establish clear accountability across teams with overlapping responsibilities and different risk tolerances. - Know how to balance launch speed with safety controls, monitoring, rollback criteria, and longer-term system development. - Communicate clearly with operational, technical, legal, and executive audiences when evidence is incomplete or tradeoffs are difficult. - Are highly practical and willing to build the workflow, not only define the strategy. - Experience supporting consumer hardware, connected devices, or other products used in shared environments. - Experience with product-safety investigations, recalls, field failures, safety advisories, or hazardous-product handling. - Experience designing workflows involving privacy-sensitive sensor, diagnostic, media, or household data. - Familiarity with warranty, repair, reverse logistics, identity recovery, fraud, or ownership disputes. - Experience building vendor training, quality-assurance, incident-response, or specialist-review programs. Partner with the IPV / valuations team (including Lincoln) on pricing and cashflow support given the use of transaction models in the valuation process.
QUALIFICATIONS
Bachelor's degree with 4-6+ years of relevant experience at an asset manager, insurance company or related field; Master's degree a plus.
Understanding of structured asset-based finance investments.
Strong analytical and problem-solving skill set.
Ability to work effectively with Portfolio Managers and senior management.
Excellent communication and interpersonal skills to operate in a fast-paced, team environment.
Proficiency in Microsoft Office (Excel, PowerPoint, Word); VBA and Visio experience a plus.
Self-starter with the ability to work independently and build robust processes.
Curiosity about and openness to adopting emerging AI technologies in day-to-day workflows.
CRITICAL COMPETENCIES FOR SUCCESS
Rigorous attention to detail and data integrity across models, reports and reconciliations.
Strong ownership mindset — takes projects from initiation through completion with minimal supervision.
Comfort engaging directly with rating agencies, TPAs and senior internal stakeholders.
Ability to synthesize complex structured-finance data into clear insights and recommendations.
Team orientation with a collaborative, solution-oriented approach in a fast-paced environment.

Senior Staff Engineer – Gateway Services
The Gateway Services team is responsible for building Coupang’s traffic infrastructure layer using Service Mesh. Key aspects of the infrastructure layer include service discovery, load balancing, traffic resiliency, traffic management, failure recovery, and observability paradigms. The job position entails the following:
Develop and implement enterprise-wide fine-grained traffic control using state-of-the-art technologies (Istio/Envoy, Kubernetes, ArgoCD, SPIFFE)
Partner for success with cross-functional teams both within the platform organization and with the stakeholder teams to drive results.
Be an evangelist and thought leader espousing the principles and benefits of traffic management for the wider benefit of the company.
We are looking for a [Senior Staff Engineer]/[Staff Engineer] who has a deep understanding of the interplay of large scale microservices and hands-on experience with Service Mesh. You will be responsible for designing the architecture and driving the team to deliver a modern platform that powers the entirety of Coupang’s services.
Job Description
As a [Senior Staff Software Engineer]/[Staff Software Engineer] in the Gateway Services team, you will partner with leaders of multiple Platform teams. You will implement seamless solutions to complex infrastructure problems, building a highly scalable, reliable, and efficient platform for our customers. You will be accountable for raising the bar on engineering and operational excellence. In this role, you will:
Build Service Mesh components collaborating actively within a small, highly talented team.
Design and implement infrastructure components related to traffic management using Rust/C++/Go.
Architect workload and service management infrastructure by designing and developing critical infrastructure components.
Decompose complex problems into simple, straightforward solutions following Coupang's leadership principles "Move with Urgency" and "Ruthless Prioritization".
Demonstrate excellence resulting in scalable systems and services with the highest quality architecture and design.
Dive deep into critical system issues, proactively addressing similar root causes, and raising the bar on Operational Excellence.
Collaborate with other Coupang technical leaders to make the service extensible and unlock opportunities for innovations.
Qualifications
Bachelor’s degree in computer science or related technical field.
[12+]/[8+] years of professional software development experience with at least 2+ years of experience as a Technical Lead.
Experience in designing and implementing traffic management solutions to handle requests at scale.
Hands-on experience in designing and developing large scale distributed systems, at least the past three years.
Strong experience in designing and implementing Service Mesh (Istio) features.
Excellent development skills in Go/Rust/C++ with a proven track record of delivering mission critical systems.
Experience with cloud computing using AWS or Azure or GCP.
Preferred Qualifications
Deep understanding of network components (virtual networks, route tables, subnets, and gateways).
Deep understanding of modern web applications design architecture and API design patterns with high performance and scale.
Ability to handle multiple competing priorities in a fast-paced environment and lead the delivery of large-scale services for complex business offerings.
